1. Put your AirPods in your ears.
2. Double-click Start.command (first time: right-click > Open > Open).
3. Enter the host laptop's IP and your player number.
4. Game: open the link it prints in Chrome, look straight ahead, press Enter.
   Slack bot: motion is also sent to the bot (port 9001), so breaks count your reps automatically.
Apple Silicon Macs only (built on arm64).
